mapper.select: SELECT file_system_part_file_id, COUNT(*) as total_chunks, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_part_chunk_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_chunks, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_part_chunk_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processing_chunks, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_part_chunk_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_chunks, SUM(CASE WHEN file_system_part_chunk_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_chunks, SUM(IFNULL(file_system_part_chunk_size, 0)) as total_chunk_size, AVG(IFNULL(file_system_part_chunk_size, 0)) as avg_chunk_size, MAX(file_system_part_retry_count) as max_retry_count, MIN(file_system_part_upload_time) as first_upload_time, MAX(file_system_part_upload_time) as last_upload_time FROM file_system_part WHERE file_system_part_file_id = #{fileId} GROUP BY file_system_part_file_id
mapper.delete: DELETE fsp FROM file_system_part fsp LEFT JOIN file_system fs ON fsp.file_system_part_file_id = fs.file_system_id WHERE fs.file_system_id IS NULL
